alert.recommendation: Review the Fabric OS switch state and logs; confirm whether the switch is intentionally disabled or undergoing a controlled reboot.
Inspect the physical link, optic, attached endpoint, and Fabric OS port diagnostics.
Check airflow and replace the affected fan or PSU/fan FRU according to the hardware guide.
Check the power feed and replace the affected PSU according to Dell/Brocade service guidance.
Check ambient temperature, airflow direction, obstructions, and fan/PSU state.
